department: Artie McFerrin Department of Chemical Engineering

deadline.value: International applicants apply by December 1 for fall (domestic December 15); applications before deadlines get priority review.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test applies to this field.

supervisor.value: You apply to the program as a whole; advisors are chosen after seminars in the first fall semester.
supervisor.quote: Applicants do not need to contact a faculty member to be considered for the program. All applications are received for admissions to the program as a whole.

funding.value: All PhD students are fully funded with stipend, tuition, fees and health insurance ($35,000 a year on the funding page).
funding.quote: All of the Ph.D. students in the department are fully funded with a generous stipend, medical benefits, tuition and fees.

also.quote: Our graduate stipend for PhD students is $2,916.67/month or $35,000 annually.

entry_route.value: You can enter after a bachelor's (96 credit hours) or a master's (64 credit hours).
entry_route.quote: To earn a PhD, students must complete 96 credit hours beyond a baccalaureate degree or 64 credit hours beyond a master’s degree.

app_fee.value: International applicants pay $90 plus the $58 EngineeringCAS fee.
app_fee.quote: International applicants must pay a $90 application fee plus the EngineeringCAS processing fee of $58.

fee_waiver.value: International fall PhD applicants can ask to waive only the $58 EngineeringCAS part of the fee.
fee_waiver.quote: International Ph.D. applicants may request a waiver of the $58 EngineeringCAS fee by submitting an online waiver form. Fee waiver requests are only considered for Fall Ph.D. applicants.

gre_general.value: The College of Engineering says GRE rules vary by program, and the chemical engineering pages checked do not state one.
